gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Mon Jun 15 13:50:46 GMT 2026
ADDED i2: getMillis with a non-existent property key returns a Duration equal to the default value. toMillisLong then converts that Duration back to the same long without
ADDED i3: ChronoUnit.FOREVER has a duration that overflows long milliseconds. toMillisLong must clamp the result to Long.MAX_VALUE instead of throwing.
ADDED i4: A duration with both negative seconds and negative nanosecond adjustment is not positive.
ADDED i5: getMillis accepts a null key and falls back to the given default value.
ADDED i6: accept() is a no-op when the duration argument is null (guard inside accept).
ADDED i7: accept() is a no-op when the consumer argument is null (guard inside accept).
ADDED i8: get() delegates to the system property (falling back to the default) and wraps the value as a Duration in the given ChronoUnit.
ADDED i9: of(FailableRunnable) measures execution time; a mock runnable that does nothing executes in effectively zero time, so the resulting duration is not positive.
ADDED i10: getMillis with a positive default returns a positive Duration.
ADDED i11: -866 minutes in milliseconds is -51,960,000 ms, which fits in an int.
ADDED i12: of(FailableConsumer) times a no-op consumer starting now; the nanoseconds-of-milli part of such a near-zero duration is 0.
ADDED i13: accept() correctly passes the milliseconds and nanoseconds of a seconds-based Duration to a nop consumer without throwing.
